lesson: T-NR and E_a are separated by complementary kernels: translation-type determinantal conditions on the xi-kernel cannot fail E_a (convolution) and fail T-NR at order 2; theta-kernel conditions of order 1-2 with the constant term cannot fail T-NR (cone) and fail E_a. Total positivity at one prime is ordered against the target: it holds exactly when parameters are real and non-tempered. Low-order minor signs of the theta kernel follow its constant term, so zeta and primitive characters differ.
